title: スプリンターズSの後に・金風に決戦を

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff, huff, pant!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I did it… I ran all the way!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I was the fiercest tempest I could be… I was a wind I can be proud of!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (It wasn't just about the wind… I got caught up in so many things.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The runner who inspired me… Teio… Ruby…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (But it all helped! Every single thing pushed me on, and filled my legs with strength…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (They lifted me up, and helped me become the true wind!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah… Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …You ran spectacularly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Let us meet again, on another grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Until then, do take care.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ruby…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes… I'll see you at our next race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Were you there? …Were you watching me?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Teio…)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Well this sucks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr puts on a truly fantastic performance at the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And it's not long afterwards that a certain someone pays a visit to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A mild wind with a hint of force rustles the red leaves of autumn.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I watched you run in the Sprinters Stakes…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: What did you think?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Geez, gimme a break!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …That's what I thought, if I'm being honest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… So—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean, come on! Seeing something like that…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Seeing you run so amazingly… There's no way I wasn't gonna get frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Like, "What the heck! Just how fast is she?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're actually gonna go ahead and surpass your Emperor, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But here I am… doing what exactly?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …There's no way I can give up after seeing that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Hey, remember what you told me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: About how you're gonna become a triple-distance champion—something not even your Emperor could pull off?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So if you're talking about doing what your Emperor tried to do but couldn't…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm guessing you're talking about winning the autumn Tenno Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes. The mile-long Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And lastly, the medium-distance autumn Tenno Sho. I will conquer all three and become the supreme wind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I thought so. But you know…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Not even my Emperor could conquer the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Two "emperors" of the same generation…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: One claimed seven whole crowns, but it was said that not even she could win a mile race against the other, the Mile Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: They clashed for the first time in the autumn Tenno Sho, but in the end, neither claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The autumn shield eluded both of them.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And that brings us to… us! Zephyr, let's face off at the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes, I see. A challenge between us to seize the shield that eluded even our Emperors.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A challenge to see which of us will surpass our model.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not messing around. Just watch me—I'm gonna pull off a full recovery, then get back on the track.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So… let's settle this at next year's autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes, let's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Yamanin Zephyr stops by my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't even need to ask what she spoke with Tokai Teio about—I can tell from the look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Let's go straight for the Mile Championship next.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I know our ultimate goal is to win next year's autumn Tenno Sho, but…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: First, I must become the dominant gale across the sprint and mile fronts.
choice_data_list: Great. The Mile Championship it is, then.
Great. The Mile Championship it is, then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll need you to train me well.
